decks.notes: This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with cards like Emberheart Challenger and Soul-Scar Mage, while also having access to direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way for your creatures. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage and Innkeeper's Talent to maximize damage output and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck incorporates powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games decisively. The deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain its aggression throughout the match to secure victory.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By combining efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero with direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to keep up the pressure and end the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Snakeskin Veil and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide protection and additional value, while the land base ensures consistent mana production for a fast and powerful aggro strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption spells. The key strategy is to maintain a fast and relentless offensive pressure while using cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's plans and clear the path for victory. With a mix of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize and mount a defense.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's plans while controlling the game through card advantage and removal spells. It utilizes hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, along with counterspells and removal spells like Fatal Push to keep the opponent's threats in check. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jace Reawakened and versatile creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to help secure the late game. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, this Dimir Control deck aims to outlast and outsmart its opponents in a grindy game of attrition.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive strategies to overwhelm opponents quickly. It includes a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the game early on, paired with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure and finish the game quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats efficiently. With a combination of efficient creatures, disruption, and removal, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is designed to support a consistent curve of threats, with options for additional mana from cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also maintaining efficient aggression with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain control with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can provide a powerful creature that can help solidify the board state. Overall, this deck seeks to win through a combination of hand disruption, aggressive creatures, and removal spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, aiming to quickly drain the opponent's life total through a combination of efficient threats and disruption. The deck utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while deploying powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure. Removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat help to clear the way for attacks, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blade of the Oni provide additional reach and flexibility in combat. The deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using efficient removal and hand disruption spells to control the game. It looks to pressure opponents with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni, supported by cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to remove threats. The deck also utilizes powerful enchantments like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to generate advantage and close out games quickly. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Duress further disrupt opponent's strategies, making it difficult for them to stabilize and recover.

The Mono Black Control deck relies on disrupting opponents through hand disruption, removal spells, and card advantage using cards such as Duress, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil. Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium provide additional value by turning discarded cards into resources. The deck aims to control the game, gradually wearing down opponents with removal spells and disruption while building up card advantage. Ultimately, the Mono Black Control deck seeks to establish dominance over the game by stripping opponents of resources and preventing them from executing their game plan effectively.

The Gruul Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and burn spells. By playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary early on, and following up with burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command, the deck seeks to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Heartfire Hero provide additional reach and ways to close out games. The deck prioritizes speed and aggression to secure victories in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Arclight Phoenix aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back the powerful phoenix from the graveyard for repeatable damage and pressure. The deck includes card draw like Opt and Sleight of Hand to quickly find the necessary cards, as well as removal and disruption cards like Fiery Impulse and Stern Dismissal to control the board. Utilizing Picklock Prankster and Proft's Eidetic Memory, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of quick aggression and efficient spell casting.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using efficient creature spells and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize to control the board. By combining aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Thousand-Faced Shadow with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to quickly defeat the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Mockingbird and Moon-Circuit Hacker also provide extra utility and disruption to help secure victory.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with quick, aggressive creatures and burn spells to deal damage efficiently. The deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cunning Coyote, along with spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command to push through damage and control the board. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional sources of damage, while cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Heartfire Hero help to increase the deck's aggression and close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on casting multiple spells quickly to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal damage to the opponent. It includes card draw and manipulation spells to cycle through the deck efficiently, as well as removal spells to control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and Phoenixes, maintaining pressure and closing out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.
